title: Fanta Hub Premium
features:
Current features (and rapidly expanding)

* Antilogger
** High Security mode (prioritize security over synchronization).
** Insanely customizable while being easy to understand.
** Multitude of settings for a multitude of games.

* VIsualizer
** Rewritten from the ground up, supports a massive amount of constantly changing cframes.
** Visualizer builder: Make your own visualizer from scratch just how you want it, or use presets shared or created by other users in our server.

* Grip Positions
** Incredibly simple to use grip position system, miles better in terms of customizability compared to any other alternative .
** Grip builder: Using the previously Corrupts Hub plugin, its incredibly easy to make grip positions directly in your Roblox Studio. Create what you want, convert it, and save it. Now even someone who has no idea how to code can make their own grip positions.

* Tool Duplication
** Three different ways of duplicating tools are now available:
*** Refresh duplication (using the HD admin ;re command in games you have permission to use such commands).
*** Rejoin duplication (instead of respawning, this will make you drop tools then rejoin in order to duplicate tools exceedingly fast on good computers).
*** Respawn dupe (the same old duplication you see everywhere, can't make it better than it already is).

* Miscellaneous
** The same functions as before, but now with an easy to use client-sided mute boombox and a client-sided sync, so you first can have the best experience.

* Wide compatibility
** Every executor supports Fanta Hub, our buyers using anything from Xeno to Zenith, with 0 issues on all of them.

* True lifetime
** Fanta Hub has been pushing new versions for the past 4 years, with countless premium iterations. We have never declined a user who has purchased a lifetime key before. You pay for lifetime, you get lifetime.

SOON:

* Decoder
** Currently in development, our decoder made directly in LuaU tries every sound currently in workspace (or if someone uses an encoded id, checks every possible bait until it finds the real one) then saves it in your workspace in anywhere from a few milliseconds to a minute (depending on the amount of ids currently in workspace and/or amount of baits in someones encoded id).

* VSAL Integration
** Ever tired of searching for IDs thru countless servers? VSAL automates that and scans 150+ known artists which upload bypasses every 5 minutes, then curates them thru user reactions.
** With the VSAL integration, you'll have quick access to the most recent bypasses, with our database currently boasting an immense amount of 1569 different IDs from currently scanned creators.
